senses.gloss: f. (פְּשַׁט; v. פִּישּׁוּט) stretching out hands and feet, prostration at prayers (= h. הִשְׁתַּחֲוָיָה).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:1:5">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 43ᵈ</cite> top <he>מ׳ דתעניתא וערובתא וכ׳</he> the prostration on fast days (that it must not be done on stone floors, v.

<cite ref="Megillah 22b">Meg. 22ᵇ</cite>), and the arrangement of the calendar with regard to the seventh day of Succoth (that it should not fall on the Sabbath), v. <cite ref="P01290"><he>עֲדַבְתָּא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 1:5:4">Y. Shebi. I, 33ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 4:1:2">Y. Succ. IV, beg. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>מַפְשִׁיטוּ׳</he>.
